summary: Keep legacy song occurrence source generation frozen, but allow already-migrated public song export files to be staged by normal public export workflows.

required_workflow_changes.change: Continue skipping build_song_occurrences.py and calibrate_song_predictions.py while data/master_rdb_migration_freeze.json exists, but stage data/public/event_songs_public.json and data/public/event_song_occurrences_public.json even during the Ph1 release state.
Same as collect.yml: keep legacy source generation frozen, but allow staging of the two migrated public song export files.
Keep commit/push guard active. Local backfill still calls build_song_occurrences.py, so it must not commit/push until Ph2 or a separate legacy-skip mode is implemented.
Do not delete the file. Add an explicit released_files/public_export_release section, and leave active=true for legacy source freeze.

recommended_freeze_schema.reason: Group-based state records both what remains frozen and what has been released, including actions as well as files.

b_sqlite_public_export_source: export_public_events.py reads that file and emits public song hints
Actions must not regenerate it through build_song_occurrences.py
c_freeze_granularity: Unknown or malformed state is frozen
Only explicit active=false releases a group
e_rollback: Stop staging the two public song export files
Revert public JSON files if needed
Revert bon-odori-site deploy commit a573473 if needed and rerun Deploy static site

examples: 赤坂浄土寺盆踊り大会

major_categories.note: Mostly null keys absent from site output.

collector_site_events_public_divergence.interpretation: The divergence is mainly historical/season/date-prediction post-processing and fixed-date-rule exposure, not the Ph1 song occurrence migration. Do not deploy collector events_public wholesale to site until this is reconciled.

rationale: Ph1 public outputs have been deployed and independently verified.
Re-enabling build_song_occurrences.py now could regenerate data/song_occurrences.json through the old JSON path and diverge from the SQLite source of truth.
Normal public event export should be able to commit event_songs_public.json after Notion-driven event changes, as long as its song occurrence input remains SQLite-derived.
The freeze file must remain present because current workflows use its existence to stop legacy source generation.
